record.headline: Anthropic split its Max plan into Max at $100 and a separately named Ultra at $200, replacing the Max 20x option.
rows: Top tier usage vs Pro, weekly
Higher output limits for all tasks
record.who: Max subscribers and anyone choosing between the $100 and $200 tiers; the saved text does not say how existing 20x subscribers are moved.
record.read: The prices and API credits carry over, but the top tier is now labelled 10x Pro usage per week instead of 20x, so the same $200 may buy less weekly usage. Having Ultra as its own named plan also lets Anthropic change the top tier without touching Max.
record.caveat: The 20x label and the 10x weekly figure may not be measured the same way; the old plan's weekly limits are not shown in the saved text.
